caption: What if every one of the roughly 8.3 billion people on Earth moved into ONE giant building? Give each person a tiny 10 square metre room and build on a 1 km by 1 km plot. That's 1 lakh rooms per floor, so you'd need about 83,000 floors. At 3 metres per floor, floor 2,950 is level with the top of Mount Everest (8,849 m), planes cruise past around floor 3,700, and near floor 33,000 you cross the 100 km Kármán line, where space officially begins. The roof would sit about 250 km up, still below the International Space Station, which orbits at about 400 km. The catch: the world's fastest lift tops out at about 21 metres per second, so ground to roof would take over 3 hours. (No real material could hold this up, and you'd need air pumped in. It's just maths!) Which floor would YOU live on? 👇
